messages:
raj_sales: Passing Nebulite (nebulite.ai) to CS — enterprise mid-market, signed for 12mo starting 2026-04-01. Main asks: VPC private deploy (data residency in EU), SSO via Okta, dedicated pool estimate. Renewal cadence noted. :wave:
leah_csm: Thanks @raj_sales — I'll own onboarding. Quick Qs: do they need SOC2/contract escalations? Who is the technical lead on their side? :eyes:
raj_sales: vendor legal confirmed SOC2 in contract addendum. Technical lead is Ana Gomez (ana@nebulite.ai). Sales note: they're high-touch, health = green but timeline tight. Risk: SSO integration could slip onboarding by 2-3 weeks.
ev an_enablement: looping in enablement — we'll set a kickoff training + admin walkthrough. Suggested session: 60m + Q/A. When do they want it? :calendar:
maria_eng: Eng heads-up: private VPC + dedicated pool -> infra estimate needed. Are they bringing their own cloud? (they're GCP EU-central). Also need model variant details for quantization/throughput planning.
raj_sales: They want Redwood Private in their GCP account (VPC peering). Models: open-llama-13b-lf and a smaller 7B for dev. Expected qps: 6 sustained, peaks ~18.
leah_csm: Action items I captured — will create a single triage thread. Short playbook snippet below for handoff checklist:
```
- Contract: signed + SOC2 addendum ✅
- Kickoff: schedule by 2026-03-25
- Infra ticket: INF-789 (create for VPC + dedicated capacity)
- SSO ticket: SSO-212 (okta SAML config + test user)
- Enablement: schedule 60m admin + 30m dev session
- Owner: @leah_csm; Eng owner: @maria_eng; Support triage: @tomas_support
```
raj_sales: I'm going to drop Ana and procurement on the thread and share the onboarding doc link: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/nebulite (internal).
tomas_support: I'll subscribe to INF-789 and SSO-212 once created. For support SLAs — they requested 24/7 on-call during launch week, please confirm budget/ops.
leah_csm: Confirmed with sales: launch-week on-call approved (extra ops hours committed). I'll add to the runbook.
ev an_enablement: Can we do admin training week-of-2026-03-29? Prefer Tue/Wed mornings PT. I'll prep slides + tenant creds.
maria_eng: For INF-789 I'll need: project ID, service account emails, expected persistent volume sizes, and network CIDR. Raj — can you confirm project ID and contact?
raj_sales: Project ID: nebulite-prod-eu. Sent service account contact to Ana. Also flagged procurement for service account creation.
leah_csm: Creating CS ticket now: CS-5543. I'll paste updates there and link INF-789 + SSO-212. Please add short customer context and any docs.
calendar-bot: Calendar invite created: "Nebulite Onboarding Kickoff" 2026-03-30 09:00-10:00 PT with participants raj_sales, leah_csm, ana_g (guest), evan_enablement.
maria_eng: Created INF-789 (internal) — description: "Nebulite Private deploy GCP EU: VPC peering, dedicated pool sizing (13B + 7B), storage 1TB)." Link: https://redwood.example.com/tickets/INF-789
tomas_support: Noted CS-5543 + INF-789. I'll create support runbook stub and a Pager duty schedule for launch week.
leah_csm: Next steps (owners):
- @maria_eng: finalize infra estimate + ETA (INF-789) — due 2026-03-26
- @tomas_support: runbook + on-call schedule — due 2026-03-28
- @evan_enablement: training material + invite — due 2026-03-27
- @raj_sales: intro to Ana + procurement updates — ongoing
I'll follow up in CS-5543 with a checklist. Any blockers? :point_up:
raj_sales: No blockers from sales side. I'll monitor Okta provisioning with Ana. Thanks team — appreciate quick turnaround on the estimate. :thumbsup:
